scope: Prespecified matched temporal phase-augmentation continuation. Frozen before new fitting or validation scores.
hypothesis: Expose the fixed backbone/head to different within80ms alignments of each original training TTS waveform. No speed/rate/duration, original source, threshold-policy or held-out changes. The small training pilot shows score variability, not proof of physical-miss cause.

arms.control: Original environmental feature view only; repeat prior control to verify artifact identity.
arms.phase: Same initial weights/recipe, plus one new uniformly offset view per original training TTS source.

selection: Select highest macro recall on validation at <=.5 continuous false events/hour, tie lower FAR then lower confusing rate then earlier checkpoint. Retain strict/near-phrase diagnostics; freeze before existing paired/long regression. No reserved scores, no acceptance without physical/resource/voice-chain tests.
ptq: Same512original training representative histories, independently byte-verified. New phase views excluded from PTQ selection.
remaining_acceptance: Freeze selected head/threshold or equal-mean threshold on original validation before old development regression. Reserved and P4/acoustic/long-call gates remain separate.
